title: Cloud Paint Dual-Ended Cheek Blush Brush
descriptionHtml:
What it is: A travel-friendly, dual-ended blush brush designed for seamless application of both liquid and powder blushes.

Brush Formulation: All Formulas

Brush Coverage: Buildable

Bristle Type: Synthetic

Ingredient Callouts: It is vegan and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This dual-ended brush has one end that is a retractable, tapered synthetic brush for blending Cloud Paint Plush Blush (or any powder blush). The other features a soft, non-absorbent silicone tip that mimics fingertips—perfect for blending Cloud Paint (or any liquid blush).
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Remove the cap from the fiber brush end and twist the barrel to reveal the soft bristles.
-Tap or swirl the brush into Cloud Paint Plush Blush, then buff onto cheeks in circular motions.
-Twist the brush back down before replacing the cap.
-For Cloud Paint: Remove the cap from the silicone applicator end.
-Use the applicator to blend and diffuse Cloud Paint with a gentle tapping motion.
